The final answer should name the same organ as that supported finding. If the evidence is only a generic label, absent from the report, or contradicted by another observation, do not finalize from the prior answer; resolve the conflict first. If displayed choices exist, also map the supported organ text to the displayed option and verify the letter and text agree. In this case, “heart” is consistent with the cited right-atrial line finding and the report’s statement that the lungs are clear, but a correct grade alone does not replace this evidence check.
